text:
maya_vp: Opening live thread for follow-ups from today's engineering roadmap Q&A. Keep items short.
jordan_runtime: What's the immediate plan for batching defaults across Hosted vs Dedicated?
sam_engineer: Hosted: adaptive batcher, max_batch_tokens=4096, latency_target=50ms. Dedicated: higher throughput, max_batch_tokens=8192, latency_target=80ms.
elena_ml: Noticed 32k models spike tail latency. Any mitigation timeline?
jordan_runtime: Kernel team prototyping sequence-aware attention bounds; aim for Q2 canary.
ryan_sre: Will SLOs be per-route or per-model? We need to wire alerts.
maya_vp: Per-route SLOs in Console with model defaults; alerts configurable. Shipping next Console deploy.
claire_prod: Prewarm vs on-demand guidance for PLG apps?
sam_engineer: Prewarm for latency-sensitive endpoints; on-demand + autoscale for bursty; use cache TTLs to smooth cold starts.
ops-bot: autoscale: policy change applied to prod-pool-1 :white_check_mark:
jordan_runtime: KV cache eviction today: heuristic-LRU favoring recent prefixes; planning sticky-prefix window for session agents.
elena_ml: Tunables: cache.max_items=200k, cache.prefix_sticky_window=4h.
claire_prod: Who runs kernel v3 rollout? Gates?
jordan_runtime: Kernel team, canary 5->20->100%, rollback on 95p latency and token errors. Playbook incoming.
maya_vp: Action: jordan publish rollout playbook by Friday EOD.
ryan_sre: Request: add per-route cost cap metric in Console.
claire_prod: Also show effective quantization (int8/int4) per model in UI.
maya_vp: Product + Console to triage.
sam_engineer: New quant default?
elena_ml: Default int8; auto-int4 after perf checks.
ops-bot: incident-bot: alert rule created kernel-latency-95th>400ms :bell:
ryan_sre: Can Applied ML publish fallback ordering (accuracy/latency/cost)?
maya_vp: Yes, draft next week.
jordan_runtime: Router supports dry_run=true for canaries to validate without routing impact; will add Console toggle.
maya_vp: Thanks all. Drop docs/PR links here. Closing after EOD unless blockers.
sam_engineer: https://redwood.internal/docs/prewarming-guides
elena_ml: https://redwood.internal/notes/cache-sticky-prefixes
jordan_runtime: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kernel-v3-rollout
claire_prod: +1 and test case added to prod tests.
